scope: read-only static scan of the on-disk game executable; no game or trainer process was started

matcher.description: Scan raw file bytes for complete signatures fully contained in IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE sections. * expands to one wildcard byte. sN.M captures M bytes, and s2.1.*.0x30.0x40 is treated as a one-byte capture with inclusive range 0x30..0x40. The latter interpretation is inferred from a unique match, capture byte 0x30, and the script patch offset aligning with the matched F3 0F 10 4D s1 instruction. The trainer parser was not executed. Each match records 64 preceding and following bytes plus matched bytes.

tokens.interpretation: The .*.0x30.0x40 suffix is treated as a one-byte capture range modifier, not three following bytes.

aa06_diagnostic.single_capture_byte_interpretation: The custom token contributes one captured byte; 0x30 and 0x40 are treated as inclusive bounds. The patch is at aobskillcd+0x1D, which is byte offset 29; with this interpretation the tail begins exactly at offset 29. The one valid target match has s2=0x30 and s1=0xA8.
aa06_diagnostic.interpretation: The tail by itself is too common. Prefix and range constraints reduce this to a single match.
